name: Life's Legacy
oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
Draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
blocked_sentences: Draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.

needs.what: an `as` on a spell's `additional_cost.sacrifice` that snapshots the sacrificed creature (608.2h last-known information, as an activated ability's sacrifice cost does through `costs.pay`'s `bindings`) into the spell's stack bindings, so `spell_effects` can read `{"power_of": {"binding": <as>}}` as a `draw` amount on resolution
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cost.sacrifice.as` loads only on an activated ability's cost (`loader.mana` refuses it elsewhere: 'only an activated ability's effects can read what its cost sacrificed'), so `additional_cost: {sacrifice: ...}` pays the sacrifice and binds nothing; the `sacrifice` op with `snapshot` would pay on resolution rather than as a cost, and `power_had`/`power_of` have no other handle on the sacrificed creature
